description.value: Cariboo Lodge Resort is a rustic log hotel in the heart of historic Clinton, BC, operating for over 41 years at the base of the Limestone Marble Range along the historic Cariboo Highway between Vancouver and Prince George. The property features an on-site pub and restaurant serving homestyle comfort food in a Western-themed atmosphere complete with a wood-burning fireplace, pool table, and outdoor patio. It sits close to multiple BC Provincial Parks offering hiking, mountain biking, fishing, and canoeing, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists traversing this stretch of the Cariboo.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides detailed information about the property. Key amenity evidence comes from the /location subpage (surveillance cameras, large parking area, WiFi mention on the front page: 'comforts of civilization such as TV and WiFi') and the restaurant/pub subpages confirming on-site evening food. No mention of bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) anywhere on the site. A fax number discrepancy was found between OSM (+12504570123) and the website contact page (250-459-0060).
concerns: Fax number discrepancy: OSM records fax as +12504570123, but the website contact page lists 250-459-0060. These are different numbers.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible motel with an active website, on-site food, and a prime location on the Cariboo Highway — a natural stop for touring cyclists on this route.

wow_evidence: operating for over 41 years at the base of the Limestone Marble Range along the historic Cariboo Highway
